“We want to be the HQ of commerce growth, where merchants and publishers can get their commerce off the ground,” said Holger Stern, co-founder and COO of 72Lux.
As more publishers populate the platform in the long term, the ad network anticipates that merchants can utilize its wholesale model for product marketing on Yahoo and Google as well.
Launched in 2014 by Columbia University graduates Thomas Lisek and Arne Lisek, the platform got its start by attracting premium merchants, including Ralph Lauren, Christian Louboutin, or Betsey Johnson, to sell on Bergdorf’s Goodman and Vogue.com.
